LanguageData.TKKN_NPS_LavaHasEruptedNearbyTxt: Lava is bubbling to the surface! Move your stuff away from the lava before it's damaged.
LanguageData.TKKN_NPS_DroughtTxt: There's no rain in the forecast for a very long time.
LanguageData.TKKN_NPS_WildFlowerBloomTxt: An unusual amount of wildflowers are blooming! Make sure you go outside to see it. Watch out for allergies!
LanguageData.TKKN_NPS_SuperbloomTxt: A record setting amount of wildflowers are blooming! Make sure you go outside to see it. Watch out for allergies!
LanguageData.NPS_doWeather_text: If unchecked, none of the below will happen. If checked, only the ones checked below will happen.
LanguageData.NPS_weatherCellUpdateSpeed_text: 5 cells are scanned every tick. When effects that change terrain occur, this will increase up to the value specified.\n\nHigher numbers can lead to temporary performance loss, but weather changes will resolve faster.
LanguageData.NPS_OnlyTargetPlayerHome_text: Only maps considered settlements will receive weather effects.
LanguageData.NPS_useMapTemperature_text: Use the maps outdoor temperature instead of querying each cell. This applies for ice freezing and frost grid generation.\nWill improve performance but can lead to frost generating indoors.
LanguageData.NPS_numModsPatching: {0} mod(s) currently detected patching functions this option uses heavily
LanguageData.NPS_doIce_text: Terrain can freeze at cold temperatures
LanguageData.NPS_FrostGrid_text: When it gets cold, frost can appear on the map. This is purely visual
LanguageData.NPS_showRainEffects_text: Show effects that can occur when it rains
LanguageData.NPS_noTerrainEffects_text: Terrain will not change when it rains
LanguageData.NPS_showWetTerrain_text: Terrain like soil will change to wet variants of itself when it rains
LanguageData.NPS_showFloodTerrain_text: Terrain like mud will change to shallow water when it rains
LanguageData.NPS_showRainAndFloodTerrain_text: both terrains will change when it rains
LanguageData.NPS_showrainGrid_text: When it rains, tiles will gradually darken to simulate rain. This is purely visual
LanguageData.NPS_rainIncreaseFertility_text: When it rains, plants will grow faster\n\nRequires restart
LanguageData.NPS_notRecommendedWetFertility: For balancing reasons, it is not recommended to use this with "Show wet terrain" option
LanguageData.NPS_makePuddles_text: Puddles can appear when it rains or when snow melts.
LanguageData.NPS_doFloods_text: Rivers will rise and fall due to season or weather. This will impact any crops placed there
LanguageData.NPS_doTides_text: Oceans will rise and fall throughout the day
LanguageData.NPS_doWetSand_text: Sand underneath ocean tides will be wet. Requires "Reset map" to add/remove
LanguageData.NPS_leaveLoot_text: After water recedes, items can wash up on land
LanguageData.NPS_forbidLoot_text: Loot that spawns from tide will be forbidden by default
LanguageData.NPS_allowLavaEruption_text: Allow volcanoes to erupt. Rocks of lava will fall on your map and take some time to go away.
LanguageData.NPS_spawnLavaOnlyInBiome_title: Volcano eruptions outside of volcanic fields
LanguageData.NPS_spawnLavaOnlyInBiome_text: Allow volcanoes to erupt in other biomes. If unchecked, volcanic eruptions will only happen in the Volcanic Fields biome
LanguageData.NPS_doAmbientTemperature_text: Temperature of a pawn can be affected by the terrain they are standing on. Note that this can be performance heavy.\n\nRequires restart
LanguageData.NPS_allowPlantEffects_text: Plants will have graphical effects applied during different seasons.\n\nRequires restart
LanguageData.NPS_seasonalDiseases_text: Possible diseases can change each month/season.\n\nRequires restart to reset
LanguageData.NPS_seasonalIncidents_text: Possible incidents can change each month/season.\n\nRequires restart to reset
LanguageData.NPS_seasonalWeather_text: Possible weather can change each month/season.\n\nRequires restart to reset
LanguageData.NPS_allowPawnEffects_text: Specific effects that can be applied to pawns.
LanguageData.NPS_pawnEffectsOnlyColonists_text: Only colonists will be affected by these effects.
LanguageData.NPS_springEffects_text: Pawns will get effects from standing/resting on springs. This is always active.
LanguageData.NPS_doDirtPath_text: Pawns will create natural paths when walking
LanguageData.NPS_doWalkThroughSnow_text: When pawns through snow it will remove some snow underneath the pawn.
LanguageData.NPS_DoColdBreath_text: When it gets cold, pawns will occasionally emit cold breath effects. This is more noticeable than base game cold breath.
LanguageData.NPS_allowPawnsToGetWet_text:
Pawns will get a wetness hediff when in water or rain. It will affect their comfortable temperature.
This will also slightly increase how long the "Soaking wet" thought is applied.

Requires restart to reset.
LanguageData.NPS_allowPawnsToSwim_text: Pawns will have their lower body disappear when in the water. This is purely cosmetic.\n\nRequires restart
LanguageData.NPS_allowPawnsToDrown_text: If a pawn is downed in the water, they might drown
LanguageData.NPS_showDevReadout_text: Show dev in the bottom left
LanguageData.NPS_reapplyMap_text: Remove and reapply all effects on the current map:
LanguageData.NPS_removeEffects_text: Remove all effects on the current map and prevent new ones from taking effect:
LanguageData.NPS_RemovalFinished: Weather effect removal has been completed
